## 2. Final `Frame` structure

```java
@Entity
@Table(name = "frames")
public class Frame {

    @Id
    @Column(name = "frame_id", nullable = false, updatable = false, length = 64)
    private String frameId;

    @Column(name = "type_classic_digital", nullable = false)
    private String mediaType;

    @Column(name = "format", nullable = false)
    private String format;

    @Column(name = "environment", nullable = false)
    private String environment;

    @Column(name = "status", nullable = false)
    private String status;

    @Column(name = "status_reason")
    private String statusReason;

    @Column(name = "created_date", nullable = false)
    private LocalDateTime createdDate;

    @Column(name = "modified_date", nullable = false)
    private LocalDateTime modifiedDate;

    @Embedded
    private LocationDetails location;

    @Embedded
    private SiteDetails site;

    @Embedded
    private TechnicalDetails technical;

    @Embedded
    private CommercialDetails commercial;

    @Embedded
    private IntegrationDetails integrations;
}
```

`frameId` will have no public setter. The update DTO will not contain it, and unknown JSON properties will be rejected so an attempted `frameId` update produces a validation error rather than being silently ignored.

### `LocationDetails`

```java
@Embeddable
public class LocationDetails {
    private String postcode;
    private String postcodeArea;
    private String postcodeDistrict;
    private String postcodeSector;
    private String postcodeUnit;

    private String address;
    private String region;
    private String countryCode;
    private String town;

    private BigDecimal longitude;
    private BigDecimal latitude;
    private Integer distanceToClosestSchool;

    private String rawLocationPoint;
    private String locationId;
}
```

### `SiteDetails`

```java
@Embeddable
public class SiteDetails {
    private String siteNumber;
    private String inventorySiteNumber;
    private String panelNumber;
    private String station;
    private String airport;
}
```

Identifiers remain strings even where the sample contains numeric values.

### `TechnicalDetails`

```java
@Embeddable
public class TechnicalDetails {
    private String illuminationTypeId;
    private Integer numberOfSlots;

    private String sizeCode;
    private String sizeGroupCode;
    private String aspectRatioCode;
    private String sizeCategory;

    private Integer pixelHeight;
    private Integer pixelWidth;
}
```

### `CommercialDetails`

```java
@Embeddable
public class CommercialDetails {
    private BigDecimal impactWeight;
    private String productionRateCard;
    private String legacyProductionRateCard;
    private String pricingGrade;
    private String priceEntityId;
    private Boolean premium;
}
```

Rate cards remain strings because the CSV gives no populated values from which to establish a numeric or currency format.

### `IntegrationDetails`

```java
@Embeddable
public class IntegrationDetails {
    private String broadsignDisplayUnitId;
    private String broadsignFrameId;
    private String broadsignDomainId;
    private String linkedFrameIds;
}
```

`linkedFrameIds` remains comma-separated storage because no relationship traversal or linked-frame editing is required.

## 3. CSV column coverage

All 45 CSV columns will be mapped.

| Destination | CSV columns |
|---|---|
| `Frame` | `frame_id`, `type_classic_digital`, `format`, `environment`, `created_date`, `modified_date`, `status`, `status_reason` |
| `LocationDetails` | `postcode`, `postcode_area`, `postcode_district`, `postcode_sector`, `postcode_unit`, `address`, `region`, `country_code`, `town`, `longitude`, `latitude`, `distance_to_closest_school`, `location`, `location_id` |
| `SiteDetails` | `site_no`, `inventory_site_no`, `panel_number`, `station`, `airport` |
| `TechnicalDetails` | `illumination_type_id`, `number_of_slots`, `size_code`, `size_group_code`, `aspect_ratio_code`, `pixel_height`, `pixel_width`, `t_size` |
| `CommercialDetails` | `impact_weight`, `production_rate_card`, `production_rate_card_legacy`, `pricing_grade`, `price_entity_id`, `premium` |
| `IntegrationDetails` | `broadsign_display_unit_id`, `broadsign_frame_id`, `broadsign_domain_id`, `linked_frame_ids` |

Nothing is intentionally discarded. Redundant values such as `location` and postcode components are retained for faithful import but are not treated as authoritative over latitude, longitude, and full postcode.

## 4. Request and response DTOs

### Create

```java
record CreateFrameRequest(
    String frameId,
    String mediaType,
    String format,
    String environment,
    String status,
    String statusReason,
    LocationDto location,
    SiteDto site,
    TechnicalDto technical,
    CommercialDto commercial,
    IntegrationDto integrations
) {}
```

`createdDate` and `modifiedDate` are system-controlled for manual creation.

### Update

```java
record UpdateFrameRequest(
    String mediaType,
    String format,
    String environment,
    String status,
    String statusReason,
    LocationDto location,
    SiteDto site,
    TechnicalDto technical,
    CommercialDto commercial,
    IntegrationDto integrations
) {}
```

It deliberately excludes:

- `frameId`
- `createdDate`
- `modifiedDate`

The endpoint uses full-resource `PUT` semantics for editable fields.

### Full response

```java
record FrameResponse(
    String frameId,
    String mediaType,
    String format,
    String environment,
    String status,
    String statusReason,
    LocalDateTime createdDate,
    LocalDateTime modifiedDate,
    LocationDto location,
    SiteDto site,
    TechnicalDto technical,
    CommercialDto commercial,
    IntegrationDto integrations
) {}
```

### List response

`FrameSummaryResponse` contains only table data:

- Frame ID
- Media type
- Format
- Environment
- Status
- Address
- Town
- Region
- Postcode
- Site/station/airport identifiers
- Distance to school
- Modified date

`FramePageResponse` contains:

```java
record FramePageResponse(
    List<FrameSummaryResponse> items,
    int page,
    int size,
    long totalElements,
    int totalPages
) {}
```

### History response

```java
record FrameHistoryResponse(
    Long id,
    String frameId,
    HistoryEventType eventType,
    Instant occurredAt,
    HistorySource source,
    Map<String, FieldChange> changedFields
) {}
```

Entities will never be returned directly.

## 5. Repository and service responsibilities

### `FrameRepository`

- Extends `JpaRepository<Frame, String>`.
- Provides one pageable JPQL search query.
- Searches frame ID, address, postcode, town, station, airport, site identifiers, and Broadsign identifiers.
- Applies optional exact filters for status, region, environment, and format.

No Specifications abstraction is needed for the initial filter set.

### `FrameHistoryRepository`

- Saves history records.
- Retrieves history by frame ID ordered newest-first.

### `FrameService`

Responsible for:

- Search and lookup.
- Manual creation.
- Imported creation.
- Duplicate checks.
- Manual updates.
- Explicit field comparison.
- Saving frame and history together transactionally.
- Mapping entities to response DTOs.

History writing remains a private responsibility of this service; a separate auditing service is unnecessary.

### `CsvImportService`

Responsible for:

- File/header validation.
- CSV parsing.
- Iterating records.
- Mapping a CSV record into a `Frame`.
- Calling `FrameService.createImportedFrame(...)` once per valid row.
- Collecting duplicate and failure results.

Each `createImportedFrame` call is its own transaction, ensuring a frame and its import history either both persist or both fail.

### Controllers

Controllers only bind HTTP input, invoke services, and return status codes/DTOs.

## 6. REST API

| Method | Endpoint | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/frames` | Paginated summaries |
| `GET` | `/api/frames/{frameId}` | Full frame |
| `POST` | `/api/frames` | Manual creation |
| `PUT` | `/api/frames/{frameId}` | Update editable fields |
| `GET` | `/api/frames/{frameId}/history` | Newest-first history |
| `POST` | `/api/frame-imports` | Multipart CSV import |

Search example:

```text
GET /api/frames?q=waterloo&status=LIVE&region=London&environment=RAIL&format=D6&page=0&size=25
```

Responses:

- Create: `201 Created` with `Location` header and `FrameResponse`.
- Update: `200 OK` with `FrameResponse`.
- Import: `200 OK` with a mixed-success summary.
- Unknown frame: `404 Not Found`.
- Duplicate manual ID: `409 Conflict`.

History does not need pagination for this exercise.

## 7. Validation and errors

### Request validation

Use Jakarta Bean Validation:

- Required, trimmed `frameId`, media type, format, environment, status.
- Maximum string lengths aligned with database columns.
- Latitude between `-90` and `90`.
- Longitude between `-180` and `180`.
- Non-negative school distance, slot count, pixel dimensions, and impact weight.
- Valid nested DTOs through `@Valid`.
- Empty optional strings normalised to `null`.

Statuses and classification strings will not be constrained to speculative enums because the requirements do not define complete vocabularies.

### API errors

A small `@RestControllerAdvice` will return Spring `ProblemDetail` responses for:

- Bean-validation errors: `400`.
- Unknown/invalid JSON fields: `400`.
- Duplicate frame ID: `409`.
- Missing frame: `404`.
- Malformed file structure: `400`.

Validation errors will include field paths such as `location.latitude`.

### CSV errors

File-level rejection applies only when row boundaries cannot be trusted:

- Empty file.
- Missing required headers.
- Unreadable content.
- Structurally malformed quoting/CSV.

Row-level failures include:

- Missing frame ID or required field.
- Invalid number, Boolean, or timestamp.
- Out-of-range coordinates.
- Existing frame ID.
- Duplicate ID earlier in the same upload.
- Database constraint failure.

Valid rows remain persisted.

## 8. History behaviour

`frame_history` contains:

```java
Long id;
Frame frame;
HistoryEventType eventType;
Instant occurredAt;
HistorySource source;
Map<String, FieldChange> changedFields;
```

The JSON column uses Hibernate’s JSON support and Jackson already supplied by Spring Web.

### Manual creation

```text
eventType: CREATED
source: MANUAL
changedFields: {}
```

Frame and history are saved in one transaction.

### CSV import

```text
eventType: IMPORTED
source: CSV_UPLOAD
changedFields: {}
```

Each row has an independent transaction.

### Manual update

Before applying an update, `FrameService` explicitly compares every editable field.

Example:

```json
{
  "status": {
    "old": "INACTIVE",
    "new": "LIVE"
  },
  "location.postcode": {
    "old": "SW1A 1AA",
    "new": "SW1A 2AA"
  }
}
```

Rules:

- Only changed fields are included.
- `frameId`, `createdDate`, and automatic `modifiedDate` are excluded.
- `null` transitions are recorded.
- A no-op update creates no history record and does not change `modifiedDate`.
- Frame update and history insert occur in the same transaction.

## 9. Focused backend tests

### Frame service

- Creates a frame and one `CREATED` history entry.
- Rejects duplicate manual IDs without creating history.
- Returns not found for unknown IDs.
- Updates only editable fields.
- Records only fields that changed.
- Records null-to-value and value-to-null changes.
- Produces no history for a no-op update.
- Cannot change the frame ID.

### CSV import

- Imports a valid row with all 45 columns.
- Correctly parses quoted addresses containing commas.
- Preserves empty optional fields as `null`.
- Creates one `IMPORTED` history entry.
- Reports an existing frame as a duplicate.
- Reports a duplicate later in the same file.
- Imports valid rows when another row fails.
- Reports row number, frame ID, and reason.
- Rejects missing headers.
- Rejects structurally malformed CSV.
- Validates numeric, Boolean, coordinate, and timestamp fields.

### Repository search

- Keyword search across common and embedded fields.
- Exact filters can be combined.
- Search is case-insensitive.
- Pagination totals are correct.
- No-match search returns an empty page.

### Controller behaviour

- Correct `201`, `200`, `400`, `404`, and `409` responses.
- Validation errors expose useful field paths.
- An update payload containing `frameId` is rejected.
- Multipart import returns mixed row results.

No tests for getters, annotations, or trivial framework wiring.

## 10. `build.gradle` dependency changes

Add:

```gradle
implementation 'org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-data-jpa'
implementation 'org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-validation'
implementation 'org.apache.commons:commons-csv:...'

runtimeOnly 'org.mariadb.jdbc:mariadb-java-client'
testRuntimeOnly 'com.h2database:h2'
```

Reasons:

- Data JPA: required repository and MariaDB persistence support.
- Validation: request and CSV entity validation.
- Commons CSV: required for compliant parsing of quoted commas and malformed records.
- MariaDB driver: required to connect to the selected datastore.
- H2: isolated repository/application tests without requiring Docker.

Existing Spring Web already supplies Jackson. No Lombok, MapStruct, Flyway, Testcontainers, or additional test framework is planned.

For this take-home, Hibernate schema management will be used, with `create-drop` for tests and `update` for the local Docker application. The trade-off will be documented.

## 11. Docker Compose changes

Remove:

- `mongodb`
- `mongodb-data`
- `opensearch`
- `opensearch-data`
- `opensearch-dashboards`
- All backend dependencies on those services.

Retain:

- Frontend
- Backend
- MariaDB
- MariaDB persistent volume
- Existing application network

Add/configure:

- Backend JDBC URL, username, and password.
- MariaDB health check.
- Backend `depends_on` MariaDB with `service_healthy`.
- Local datasource defaults in `application.yml`.

The resulting stack will have three containers and still start with:

```bash
docker compose up --build
```

## 12. Frontend plan for later checkpoints

No frontend code will be modified during the backend foundation checkpoint.

### Application state

`App.tsx` will hold simple screen state:

```text
list | details | create | edit | history | import
```

It will also hold the selected frame ID. No router or state-management library is required.

### Main components

```text
AppShell
FrameListScreen
FrameSearchFilters
FrameTable
FrameDetailsScreen
CreateFrameScreen
EditFrameScreen
FrameForm
FrameHistory
CsvImportScreen
CsvImportResult
StatusChip
LoadingState
EmptyState
ErrorState
```

`FrameForm` will be shared between create and edit:

- Create mode includes editable `frameId`.
- Edit mode shows `frameId` as read-only and excludes it from the update request.
- Fields are sectioned using the same groupings as the backend.

### Frame list

Direction A-style dense table with:

- Keyword search.
- Status, region, environment, and format filters.
- Server-side pagination.
- Row selection leading to details.
- `New frame` and `Import CSV` actions.
- Loading, no-results, and request-error states.

### Details and history

Frame details will use grouped surfaces for:

- Core information.
- Location.
- Site.
- Technical/display.
- Commercial/pricing.
- Integration identifiers.

History will use the supplied timeline and old/new difference styling.

### CSV import

A simple screen or panel containing:

- `.csv` file input.
- Upload action.
- Upload/loading state.
- Created, duplicate, and failed counts.
- Per-row error table with row, frame ID, and reason.
- File-level malformed CSV error state.

No drag-and-drop dependency or background progress system is needed.

### Design-system reuse

Reuse:

- `tokens.css` as the styling source of truth.
- Supplied Inter fonts.
- Relevant table, field, button, chip, surface, banner, and timeline patterns.
- Inline SVG icons adapted into typed React components.
- Direction A’s page hierarchy and dense operational tone.

Do not carry over:

- Prototype routing/tweak controls.

## 5. Repository and service responsibilities

### `FrameRepository`

- Extends `JpaRepository<Frame, String>`.
- Provides one pageable JPQL search query.
- Searches frame ID, address, postcode, town, station, airport, site identifiers, and Broadsign identifiers.
- Applies optional exact filters for status, region, environment, and format.

No Specifications abstraction is needed for the initial filter set.

### `FrameHistoryRepository`

- Saves history records.
- Retrieves history by frame ID ordered newest-first.

### `FrameService`

Responsible for:

- Search and lookup.
- Manual creation.
- Imported creation.
- Duplicate checks.
- Manual updates.
- Explicit field comparison.
- Saving frame and history together transactionally.
- Mapping entities to response DTOs.

History writing remains a private responsibility of this service; a separate auditing service is unnecessary.

### `CsvImportService`

Responsible for:

- File/header validation.
- CSV parsing.
- Iterating records.
- Mapping a CSV record into a `Frame`.
- Calling `FrameService.createImportedFrame(...)` once per valid row.
- Collecting duplicate and failure results.

Each `createImportedFrame` call is its own transaction, ensuring a frame and its import history either both persist or both fail.

### Controllers

Controllers only bind HTTP input, invoke services, and return status codes/DTOs.

## 6. REST API

| Method | Endpoint | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/frames` | Paginated summaries |
| `GET` | `/api/frames/{frameId}` | Full frame |
| `POST` | `/api/frames` | Manual creation |
| `PUT` | `/api/frames/{frameId}` | Update editable fields |
| `GET` | `/api/frames/{frameId}/history` | Newest-first history |
| `POST` | `/api/frame-imports` | Multipart CSV import |

Search example:

```text
GET /api/frames?q=waterloo&status=LIVE&region=London&environment=RAIL&format=D6&page=0&size=25
```

Responses:

- Create: `201 Created` with `Location` header and `FrameResponse`.
- Update: `200 OK` with `FrameResponse`.
- Import: `200 OK` with a mixed-success summary.
- Unknown frame: `404 Not Found`.
- Duplicate manual ID: `409 Conflict`.

History does not need pagination for this exercise.

## 7. Validation and errors

### Request validation

Use Jakarta Bean Validation:

- Required, trimmed `frameId`, media type, format, environment, status.
- Maximum string lengths aligned with database columns.
- Latitude between `-90` and `90`.
- Longitude between `-180` and `180`.
- Non-negative school distance, slot count, pixel dimensions, and impact weight.
- Valid nested DTOs through `@Valid`.
- Empty optional strings normalised to `null`.

Statuses and classification strings will not be constrained to speculative enums because the requirements do not define complete vocabularies.

### API errors

A small `@RestControllerAdvice` will return Spring `ProblemDetail` responses for:

- Bean-validation errors: `400`.
- Unknown/invalid JSON fields: `400`.
- Duplicate frame ID: `409`.
- Missing frame: `404`.
- Malformed file structure: `400`.

Validation errors will include field paths such as `location.latitude`.

### CSV errors

File-level rejection applies only when row boundaries cannot be trusted:

- Empty file.
- Missing required headers.
- Unreadable content.
- Structurally malformed quoting/CSV.

Row-level failures include:

- Missing frame ID or required field.
- Invalid number, Boolean, or timestamp.
- Out-of-range coordinates.
- Existing frame ID.
- Duplicate ID earlier in the same upload.
- Database constraint failure.

Valid rows remain persisted.

## 8. History behaviour

`frame_history` contains:

```java
Long id;
Frame frame;
HistoryEventType eventType;
Instant occurredAt;
HistorySource source;
Map<String, FieldChange> changedFields;
```

The JSON column uses Hibernate’s JSON support and Jackson already supplied by Spring Web.

### Manual creation

```text
eventType: CREATED
source: MANUAL
changedFields: {}
```

Frame and history are saved in one transaction.

### CSV import

```text
eventType: IMPORTED
source: CSV_UPLOAD
changedFields: {}
```

Each row has an independent transaction.

### Manual update

Before applying an update, `FrameService` explicitly compares every editable field.

Example:

```json
{
  "status": {
    "old": "INACTIVE",
    "new": "LIVE"
  },
  "location.postcode": {
    "old": "SW1A 1AA",
    "new": "SW1A 2AA"
  }
}
```

Rules:

- Only changed fields are included.
- `frameId`, `createdDate`, and automatic `modifiedDate` are excluded.
- `null` transitions are recorded.
- A no-op update creates no history record and does not change `modifiedDate`.
- Frame update and history insert occur in the same transaction.

### Frame service

- Creates a frame and one `CREATED` history entry.
- Rejects duplicate manual IDs without creating history.
- Returns not found for unknown IDs.

    String format,
    String environment,
    String status,
    String statusReason,
    LocalDateTime createdDate,
    LocalDateTime modifiedDate,
    LocationDto location,
    SiteDto site,
    TechnicalDto technical,
    CommercialDto commercial,
    IntegrationDto integrations
) {}
```

### List response

`FrameSummaryResponse` contains only table data:

- Frame ID
- Media type
- Format
- Environment
- Status
- Address
- Town
- Region
- Postcode
- Site/station/airport identifiers
- Distance to school
- Modified date

`FramePageResponse` contains:

```java
record FramePageResponse(
    List<FrameSummaryResponse> items,
    int page,
    int size,
    long totalElements,
    int totalPages
) {}
```

### History response

```java
record FrameHistoryResponse(
    Long id,
    String frameId,
    HistoryEventType eventType,
    Instant occurredAt,
    HistorySource source,
    Map<String, FieldChange> changedFields
) {}
```

Entities will never be returned directly.

## 5. Repository and service responsibilities

### `FrameRepository`

- Extends `JpaRepository<Frame, String>`.
- Provides one pageable JPQL search query.
- Searches frame ID, address, postcode, town, station, airport, site identifiers, and Broadsign identifiers.
- Applies optional exact filters for status, region, environment, and format.

No Specifications abstraction is needed for the initial filter set.

### `FrameHistoryRepository`

- Saves history records.
- Retrieves history by frame ID ordered newest-first.

### `FrameService`

Responsible for:

- Search and lookup.
- Manual creation.
- Imported creation.
- Duplicate checks.
- Manual updates.
- Explicit field comparison.
- Saving frame and history together transactionally.
- Mapping entities to response DTOs.

History writing remains a private responsibility of this service; a separate auditing service is unnecessary.

### `CsvImportService`

Responsible for:

- File/header validation.
- CSV parsing.
- Iterating records.
- Mapping a CSV record into a `Frame`.
- Calling `FrameService.createImportedFrame(...)` once per valid row.
- Collecting duplicate and failure results.

Each `createImportedFrame` call is its own transaction, ensuring a frame and its import history either both persist or both fail.

### Controllers

Controllers only bind HTTP input, invoke services, and return status codes/DTOs.

## 6. REST API

| Method | Endpoint | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/frames` | Paginated summaries |
| `GET` | `/api/frames/{frameId}` | Full frame |
| `POST` | `/api/frames` | Manual creation |
| `PUT` | `/api/frames/{frameId}` | Update editable fields |
| `GET` | `/api/frames/{frameId}/history` | Newest-first history |
| `POST` | `/api/frame-imports` | Multipart CSV import |

Search example:

```text
GET /api/frames?q=waterloo&status=LIVE&region=London&environment=RAIL&format=D6&page=0&size=25
```

Responses:

- Create: `201 Created` with `Location` header and `FrameResponse`.
- Update: `200 OK` with `FrameResponse`.
- Import: `200 OK` with a mixed-success summary.
- Unknown frame: `404 Not Found`.
- Duplicate manual ID: `409 Conflict`.

History does not need pagination for this exercise.

## 7. Validation and errors

### Request validation

Use Jakarta Bean Validation:

- Required, trimmed `frameId`, media type, format, environment, status.
- Maximum string lengths aligned with database columns.
- Latitude between `-90` and `90`.
- Longitude between `-180` and `180`.
- Non-negative school distance, slot count, pixel dimensions, and impact weight.
- Valid nested DTOs through `@Valid`.
- Empty optional strings normalised to `null`.

Statuses and classification strings will not be constrained to speculative enums because the requirements do not define complete vocabularies.

### API errors

A small `@RestControllerAdvice` will return Spring `ProblemDetail` responses for:

- Bean-validation errors: `400`.
- Unknown/invalid JSON fields: `400`.
- Duplicate frame ID: `409`.
- Missing frame: `404`.
- Malformed file structure: `400`.

Validation errors will include field paths such as `location.latitude`.

### CSV errors

File-level rejection applies only when row boundaries cannot be trusted:

- Empty file.
- Missing required headers.
- Unreadable content.
- Structurally malformed quoting/CSV.

Row-level failures include:

- Missing frame ID or required field.
- Invalid number, Boolean, or timestamp.
- Out-of-range coordinates.
- Existing frame ID.
- Duplicate ID earlier in the same upload.
- Database constraint failure.

Valid rows remain persisted.

## 8. History behaviour

`frame_history` contains:

```java
Long id;
Frame frame;
HistoryEventType eventType;
Instant occurredAt;
HistorySource source;
Map<String, FieldChange> changedFields;
```

The JSON column uses Hibernate’s JSON support and Jackson already supplied by Spring Web.

### Manual creation

```text
eventType: CREATED
source: MANUAL
changedFields: {}
```

Frame and history are saved in one transaction.

### CSV import

```text
eventType: IMPORTED
source: CSV_UPLOAD
changedFields: {}
```

Each row has an independent transaction.

### Manual update

Before applying an update, `FrameService` explicitly compares every editable field.

Example:

```json
{
  "status": {
    "old": "INACTIVE",
    "new": "LIVE"
  },
  "location.postcode": {
    "old": "SW1A 1AA",
    "new": "SW1A 2AA"
  }
}
```

Rules:

- Only changed fields are included.
- `frameId`, `createdDate`, and automatic `modifiedDate` are excluded.
- `null` transitions are recorded.
- A no-op update creates no history record and does not change `modifiedDate`.
- Frame update and history insert occur in the same transaction.

## 9. Focused backend tests

### Frame service

- Creates a frame and one `CREATED` history entry.
- Rejects duplicate manual IDs without creating history.
- Returns not found for unknown IDs.
- Updates only editable fields.
- Records only fields that changed.
- Records null-to-value and value-to-null changes.
- Produces no history for a no-op update.
- Cannot change the frame ID.

### CSV import

- Imports a valid row with all 45 columns.
- Correctly parses quoted addresses containing commas.
- Preserves empty optional fields as `null`.
- Creates one `IMPORTED` history entry.
- Reports an existing frame as a duplicate.
- Reports a duplicate later in the same file.
- Imports valid rows when another row fails.
- Reports row number, frame ID, and reason.
- Rejects missing headers.
- Rejects structurally malformed CSV.
- Validates numeric, Boolean, coordinate, and timestamp fields.

### Repository search

- Keyword search across common and embedded fields.
- Exact filters can be combined.
- Search is case-insensitive.
- Pagination totals are correct.
- No-match search returns an empty page.

### Controller behaviour

- Correct `201`, `200`, `400`, `404`, and `409` responses.
- Validation errors expose useful field paths.
- An update payload containing `frameId` is rejected.
- Multipart import returns mixed row results.

No tests for getters, annotations, or trivial framework wiring.

## 10. `build.gradle` dependency changes

Add:

```gradle
implementation 'org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-data-jpa'
implementation 'org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-validation'
implementation 'org.apache.commons:commons-csv:...'

runtimeOnly 'org.mariadb.jdbc:mariadb-java-client'
testRuntimeOnly 'com.h2database:h2'
```

Reasons:

- Data JPA: required repository and MariaDB persistence support.
- Validation: request and CSV entity validation.
- Commons CSV: required for compliant parsing of quoted commas and malformed records.
- MariaDB driver: required to connect to the selected datastore.
- H2: isolated repository/application tests without requiring Docker.

Existing Spring Web already supplies Jackson. No Lombok, MapStruct, Flyway, Testcontainers, or additional test framework is planned.

For this take-home, Hibernate schema management will be used, with `create-drop` for tests and `update` for the local Docker application. The trade-off will be documented.

## 11. Docker Compose changes

Remove:

- `mongodb`
- `mongodb-data`
- `opensearch`
- `opensearch-data`
- `opensearch-dashboards`
- All backend dependencies on those services.

Retain:

- Frontend
- Backend
- MariaDB
- MariaDB persistent volume
- Existing application network

Add/configure:

- Backend JDBC URL, username, and password.
- MariaDB health check.
- Backend `depends_on` MariaDB with `service_healthy`.
- Local datasource defaults in `application.yml`.

The resulting stack will have three containers and still start with:

```bash
docker compose up --build
```

## 12. Frontend plan for later checkpoints

No frontend code will be modified during the backend foundation checkpoint.

### Application state

`App.tsx` will hold simple screen state:

```text
list | details | create | edit | history | import
```

It will also hold the selected frame ID. No router or state-management library is required.

### Main components

```text
AppShell
FrameListScreen
FrameSearchFilters
FrameTable
FrameDetailsScreen
CreateFrameScreen
EditFrameScreen
FrameForm
FrameHistory
CsvImportScreen
CsvImportResult
StatusChip
LoadingState
EmptyState
ErrorState
```

`FrameForm` will be shared between create and edit:

- Create mode includes editable `frameId`.
- Edit mode shows `frameId` as read-only and excludes it from the update request.
- Fields are sectioned using the same groupings as the backend.

### Frame list

Direction A-style dense table with:

- Keyword search.
- Status, region, environment, and format filters.
- Server-side pagination.
- Row selection leading to details.
- `New frame` and `Import CSV` actions.
- Loading, no-results, and request-error states.

### Details and history

Frame details will use grouped surfaces for:

- Core information.
- Location.
- Site.
- Technical/display.
- Commercial/pricing.
- Integration identifiers.

History will use the supplied timeline and old/new difference styling.

### CSV import

A simple screen or panel containing:

- `.csv` file input.
- Upload action.
- Upload/loading state.
- Created, duplicate, and failed counts.
- Per-row error table with row, frame ID, and reason.
- File-level malformed CSV error state.

No drag-and-drop dependency or background progress system is needed.

### Design-system reuse

Reuse:

- `tokens.css` as the styling source of truth.
- Supplied Inter fonts.
- Relevant table, field, button, chip, surface, banner, and timeline patterns.
- Inline SVG icons adapted into typed React components.
- Direction A’s page hierarchy and dense operational tone.

Do not carry over:

- Prototype routing/tweak controls.
- Map view.
- Master-data administration.
- Saved searches.
- Fake users or sync timestamps.
- Downstream validation claims.

### Frontend API layer

A small typed `src/api/frames.ts` module will expose:

```typescript
searchFrames(params)
getFrame(frameId)
createFrame(request)
updateFrame(frameId, request)
getFrameHistory(frameId)
importFrames(file)
```

It will use native `fetch`, parse `ProblemDetail` responses, and require no additional dependency.

## MUST FIX

None.

Verified:

- All 45 CSV columns are mapped exactly once.
- Column sizes accommodate every supplied CSV value.
- Embeddable groupings are coherent and remain in one `frames` table.
- `frame_id` is the `String` JPA identifier, has no setter, and is `updatable = false`.
- The history foreign key correctly inherits `VARCHAR(64)`.
- JSON mapping is suitable for MariaDB 11. MariaDB represents `JSON` as validated `LONGTEXT`, which is appropriate for these small audit documents. [MariaDB JSON documentation](https://mariadb.com/docs/server/reference/data-types/string-data-types/json)
- Dependencies are all justified; Commons CSV is intentionally staged for the next import checkpoint.

## SHOULD FIX

1. Repository tests are not currently using H2’s MariaDB compatibility mode.

`@DataJpaTest` replaces the configured datasource with:

```text
jdbc:h2:mem:<generated-id>
```

Therefore, the `MODE=MariaDB` URL in test configuration is only used by `ApplicationTests`.

Recommended correction:

```yaml
spring:
  test:
    database:
      replace: none
```

This is a test-accuracy issue, not a production mapping failure.

2. Before end-to-end MariaDB testing, Compose should wait for MariaDB readiness.

It currently uses `condition: service_started`, which does not guarantee MariaDB is accepting connections. A MariaDB health check with `condition: service_healthy` should be added during the planned Compose cleanup.

## OPTIONAL

- Mark `event_type`, `source`, and `changed_fields` as `updatable = false` to express append-only history more strongly. There is currently no API or setter capable of modifying them, so this is hardening rather than a defect.
- Run one real MariaDB persistence smoke test after Compose cleanup. H2 confirms JPA behaviour but cannot fully prove MariaDB dialect behaviour.
- Hibernate may generate native database enums for the two history enums. This is valid for the current fixed values; forcing `VARCHAR` is unnecessary for this exercise.

Overall, the persistence design is correct and appropriately simple. Only the `@DataJpaTest` datasource replacement is worth correcting before committing this checkpoint. No files were changed during this review.
